recreation_brief:
1. Set the full slide background to light gray #F0F0F0.
2. Place the title 'Follow Negative Direction of Gradient with Selected Learning Rate' at the top center, spanning most of the slide width; style: bold, dark red #8B0000, serif or heavy sans-serif, ~34pt (source estimate range 32–36pt).
3. Place a small filled yellow #FFFF00 circle at the top-right corner of the slide; center small black #000000 text '27' inside it.
4. Draw the graph frame: a no-fill rectangle with a thin red #FF0000 border, centered on the slide, spanning approximately 15%–85% of slide width and 25%–90% of slide height.
5. Inside the frame, draw the y-axis: a vertical black #000000 line on the left side with an arrowhead pointing up; place the black #000000 label 'Cost' above the top of the arrow.
6. Draw the x-axis: a horizontal black #000000 line along the bottom of the frame with an arrowhead pointing right; place the black #000000 Greek label 'θ' just past the right end of the line.
7. Draw a black #000000 U-shaped parabola opening upward inside the frame, with its minimum near the horizontal center of the frame.
8. Place 8 blue #0000CD dots along the left branch of the parabola, starting at the top-left (high cost) and stepping down toward the minimum; shrink the vertical spacing between consecutive dots as they approach the minimum.
9. Place 1 yellow #FFFF00 dot exactly at the parabola's minimum point.
10. Draw a black #000000 dashed vertical line from the first (highest, leftmost) blue dot straight down to the x-axis.
11. Place the black #000000 text 'Random initial value' below the dashed line in the lower-left area inside the frame.
12. Place the black #000000 text 'Learning step' to the right of the dot sequence, with a small black #000000 arrow pointing left toward the dots.
13. Place the black #000000 text 'Minimum' to the right of the yellow minimum dot.
14. Place a black #000000 '+' symbol on the x-axis, to the right of where the dashed line meets the x-axis.
15. Place the black #000000 symbol 'θ̂' below the x-axis, directly beneath the minimum point (vertically aligned with the yellow dot).
